steps.headline: 1. Session naming matches the other General cards.
steps.changed: Uses the same background, rounded corners, padding and title styling as the surrounding options.
steps.notice: The naming choices and model picker stay together inside their card.
steps.risk: This is still the isolated preview; title generation is not connected.

steps.path: Resume Session → pencil beside a name
steps.headline: 2. The pencil sits directly beside the saved name.
steps.changed: Removed the separate Rename button and its extra row. The visible pencil opens the same rename dialog.
steps.notice: The pencil is always visible, keyboard-labelled, and has a larger touch target.

steps.headline: 3. No automatic-name reset button.
steps.changed: Removed Use automatic name entirely, without adding another reset action.
steps.notice: Cancel and Save name are the only actions. Names you choose remain protected from automatic naming.
steps.risk: Saving and reopening were checked in the simulated preview, not durable backend storage.
